title: Budget verdicts
responsibility: Compares one unit’s measurements with reviewed frozen limits and compatible performance baselines, preserving missing and unavailable evidence as explicit findings.

inputs.name: isFrozen.metric
inputs.description: Metric name to test for a frozen size, complexity, dependency or emitted-artifact limit.

inputs.name: budgetFindings.input
inputs.description: Unit, current profile, default target, performance budgets and measurements, optional reviewed baseline, and whether source size and complexity should be checked.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.metric
inputs.description: Metric whose worse direction determines the tolerated limit; only throughput-ops treats larger values as better.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed numeric value in the same unit as the measurement.

inputs.name: performanceLimit.tolerance
inputs.description: Allowed fractional regression, such as 0.05 for five percent.

outputs.name: frozenMetrics
outputs.description: The source metrics source-bytes, complexity and dependencies whose limits never allow unreviewed growth.

outputs.name: isFrozen
outputs.description: True for those source metrics or any metric beginning with artifact-bytes.

outputs.name: budgetFindings
outputs.description: Findings for requested source checks, measured emitted targets and each performance budget. Each reports passed, exceeded, missing-baseline, missing-measurement, unavailable, incomplete or incompatible as supported by the evidence.

outputs.name: performanceLimit
outputs.description: Baseline decreased by tolerance for throughput, otherwise increased by tolerance, rounded to twelve significant digits. A value exactly at the limit remains acceptable.
